description: Add SQLAlchemy models for saved teams (single local user). Team(id, name, kind: 'player'|'opponent', notes, created/updated). TeamMember(team_id, slot 1-6, pokemon_id, ability_id nullable, nature_id nullable, ev_spread JSONB {stat:0-252, sum<=510}, iv_spread JSONB {stat:0-31}, move_ids JSONB list<=4). FKs to pokemon/abilities/natures/moves. Validation lives in schemas/service, not DB. Alembic migration (respect include_object FTS exclusion in alembic/env.py). No auth — teams belong to the sole user.
title: Team & TeamMember models + migration (player/opponent)
